text: Not only the students ____ also their tutor joined the clean-up.
cn: 不只有学生，他们的导师也参加了清扫。
why: but 构成第二部分 but also，引出同样参加的人。
tip: 不要把 but also 换成表示相反意思的 but not。
hint: 补全 not only… also… 中缺少的一词

text: The campsite was quiet ____ a few geese called from the lake.（表示「除了……这一点」。）
cn: 除了湖上传来几声雁叫，营地很安静。
why: a few geese called 是完整分句，用 except that 引出例外。
tip: except for 后通常接名词短语，不能直接接这个分句。

text: We will start the game ____ everyone has a partner.
cn: 等每个人都有搭档了，我们就开始游戏。
why: 先具备人人有搭档的条件，接着开始游戏，用 once 表示「一旦」。
tip: whereas 是对比，不表达先决条件。

text: Even ____ the sign is faded, you can still read the numbers.
cn: 尽管标牌褪色了，你仍能看清上面的数字。
why: 标牌褪色是已知事实，even though 表示尽管如此仍能看清。
tip: even if 更侧重假设；题干要求事实让步。
hint: 补成 even 开头表示事实让步的连词

text: Keep the drawing flat ____ the ink dries completely.
cn: 在墨水完全干透之前，一直把画平放着。
why: keep flat 表状态持续，dry completely 是这一要求的终点。
tip: 不要将两个动作理解为同时开始又同时结束。
hint: 填表示动作持续终点的连词

text: I turned the key twice, ____ the drawer still wouldn't open.
cn: 我把钥匙转了两次，可抽屉仍打不开。
why: 转动钥匙本应打开抽屉，still 表明预期落空，因此用 yet。
tip: as a result 表示顺理成章的结果，不能突出出乎意料。

text: There was so little room ____ we had to leave a chair outside.
cn: 地方小得我们只好把一把椅子留在外面。
why: room 表空间，是不可数名词。so little room that…说明空间少所造成的后果。
tip: 不能因为后面有名词就机械改用 such little。
hint: 补全表示结果的 so little… 结构

text: Rewrite using as soon as: She heard the whistle and immediately stopped rowing. → She stopped rowing ____ she heard the whistle.
cn: 她一听到哨声就停止划桨。
why: as soon as 将听见哨声和停桨连接起来，保留 immediately 的紧接意味。
tip: 仅用 after 不能同样明确地表达「马上」。
hint: 用题干指定的连接语表达紧接着发生

text: Rewrite with although: The bag looked small, but it held all my books. → ____ the bag looked small, it held all my books.
cn: 尽管包看起来小，却装下了我所有的书。
why: 用 Although 引导外观小这一让步情况，主句表达实际容量。
tip: 主句不再重复写 but。
hint: 以指定连词开头合并两句

text: Select both relatives that can fill the gap: The bell ____ hangs above the door is brass.
cn: 门上方悬着的铃是黄铜制的。选出都能填入的关系代词。
why: that 和 which 都能在限定性从句里指 bell 并作 hangs 的主语。
tip: whom 指人作宾语；whose 需要表所属关系。

text: Which two statements report the question “Where is the platform?” correctly?
slots: He asked where the platform was.
She wants to know where the platform is.
cn: 哪两句话都能正确转述「站台在哪里？」这个问题？
why: 过去和现在的转述都使用主语 the platform 在 be 之前的顺序。
tip: 不要把直接问句中的倒装保留在宾语从句中。
options: He asked where was the platform.
She wants to know where the platform is.
She wants to know where is the platform.
He asked where the platform was.

text: My sister draws maps, ____ I prefer taking photos. We record trips differently.
cn: 姐姐画地图，而我更喜欢拍照，我们记录旅行的方式不同。
why: 两种记录方式并列比较，whereas 用于引出对照项。
tip: because 会把其中一个人的偏好解释为另一个人行为的原因。

text: The cupboards are empty and the van is gone. The movers must ____ everything already.
cn: 柜子都空了，货车也走了。搬运工想必已经把东西全装好了。
why: 目前的迹象支持对先前装货的推测，must 后用 have loaded。
tip: must load 表示现在必须去装，无法解释已经出现的结果。
hint: 用 load 表达对过去的肯定推测

text: The seal is still unbroken. Someone ____ have opened the box through this lid.
cn: 封条还完好无损，不可能有人通过这个盖子打开过盒子。
why: 封条完整提供了否定过去动作的证据，故用 can't have opened。
tip: mustn't have 在基础用法中不表达这种强烈的否定推测。

text: We needn't ____ extra chairs; half the seats stayed empty.
cn: 我们原本不用搬来额外的椅子，有一半座位一直空着。
why: 椅子已经搬来，事后看没有必要，用 needn't have brought。
tip: didn't need to 本身未必说明最后到底做了没有。
hint: 用 bring 表达做过却没必要的事

text: I should ____ the instructions more carefully before cutting the wood.
cn: 我锯木头前本应更仔细地读说明。
why: 说话人回顾已经发生的操作，should have read 表示当时应该做得更好。
tip: 不要填 have reading；have 后是过去分词。
hint: 用 read 表达对先前行为的反思

text: The bus might ____ delayed by the roadworks yesterday.
cn: 昨天的道路施工可能耽误了那班公交车。
why: bus 承受 delay，yesterday 表过去，组合为 might have been delayed。
tip: might have delayed 会让 bus 成为耽误其他事物的主体。
hint: 填入 delayed 前缺少的完成被动结构

text: If the fire drill ends early, we may ____ use the gym after all.
cn: 如果消防演练提前结束，我们最终也许能用体育馆。
point: 情态动词与 be able to
why: may 表可能，be able to 表能做到，两种意思可借此叠加。
tip: 标准英语不用 may can 连放两个情态动词。

text: My card didn't work, but the clerk managed ____ a paper ticket for me.
cn: 我的卡没用，不过职员还是设法给我开了张纸票。
why: managed to 说明尽管遇到困难，动作最终成功完成。
tip: managed issuing 不能表达这里的固定结构。
hint: 用 issue 的正确形式填空

text: The drain is blocked; it needs ____. Use the -ing form of clean.
cn: 下水口堵住了，需要清理。（用 clean 的 -ing 形式）
why: needs cleaning 等于 needs to be cleaned，下水口是被清理的对象。
tip: 不要把语义是被动直接等同于必须写 being cleaned。
hint: 按指定形式填入 clean

text: We regret ____ you that this afternoon's tour has been canceled.
cn: 我们很遗憾地通知您，今天下午的参观已取消。
why: regret to inform 是正式通知的用法，说这句话时正要告知消息。
tip: regret informing 表示后悔已经告知过。
hint: 用 inform 的正确形式，表示即将告知坏消息

text: I regret ____ my first sketch away; it would have been a useful record.
cn: 我后悔扔掉了第一张草图，它本可以成为有用的记录。
why: 扔草图发生在后悔之前，throwing 和强调先后的 having thrown 都可。
tip: regret to throw 不表示后悔过去已扔掉。
hint: 用 throw 的动名词形式表达对已做之事的后悔

text: The wheel still squeaks. Try ____ a drop of oil; perhaps that will help.
cn: 轮子还在吱吱响。试着加一滴油看看，也许有用。
why: 加油是一种待试验的办法，用 try adding 强调看效果如何。
tip: try to add 更强调努力完成加油这个动作。
hint: 用 add 的 -ing 形式表示试用一种办法

text: Reading the second clue meant ____ back to the first room.
cn: 阅读第二条线索意味着要走回第一个房间。
why: meant walking 说明读线索所涉及的后果。
tip: meant to walk 表示本打算走，主语和意思都不同。
hint: 用 walk 的正确形式表示「意味着」

text: I meant ____ the draft to you, but I attached the wrong file.
cn: 我本想把草稿发给你，却附错了文件。
why: 主语 I 有一个意图，用 meant to send 表达。
tip: meant sending 表示意味着发送，并非描述本意。
hint: 用 send 的正确形式，表示原来的打算

text: She went on ____ how the pulley worked after she had named its parts.
cn: 她说完滑轮各部件的名称后，接着讲它的工作原理。
why: 先列名称再讲原理，是转入下一项内容，故用 to explain。
tip: go on explaining 倾向于表示继续同一项讲解。
hint: 用 explain 的不定式表示接着做另一件事

text: We had the cracked mirror ____ before the shop reopened.
cn: 商店重新开门前，我们请人换掉了裂开的镜子。
why: mirror 是 replace 的承受者，have the mirror replaced 表示安排别人更换。
tip: 不要把镜子写成 replacing 的主动者。
hint: 用 replace 的正确形式填空

text: Please keep the escape route ____ of boxes and bags.
cn: 请让逃生通道保持畅通，不摆箱包。
why: 这里说明希望 route 保持怎样的状态，用形容词 clear。
tip: 不要误以为 keep 后任何位置都只能用 -ing。

text: I found the spare key ____ to the underside of the shelf.
cn: 我发现备用钥匙被粘在架子的底面上。
why: 钥匙是被粘住的，taped 作宾语补足语描述其状态。
tip: taping 会使 key 成为粘东西的动作发出者。
hint: 用 tape 的分词形式，表示钥匙所处的状态

text: The woman ____ badges at the entrance is our neighbor.
cn: 在入口分发胸牌的那位女士是我们的邻居。
why: woman 主动分发胸牌，handing out badges 修饰她。
tip: handed out 会表示她被分发，与语意不合。
hint: 用 hand out 的现在分词形式填空

text: The photos ____ during the cleanup are on display.
cn: 大扫除期间拍摄的照片正在展出。
why: photos 与 take 是被动关系，taken during the cleanup 修饰 photos。
tip: taking 表主动，不能说照片自己拍摄。
hint: 用 take 的过去分词作定语

text: ____ the sign twice, Leo still entered the wrong corridor.（用 read 的完成分词形式。）
cn: 利奥已经把指示牌读了两遍，却还是走错了走廊。
why: 读指示牌发生在走错之前，Having read 明确先后，逻辑主语是 Leo。
tip: 不要使用 Having been read，Leo 是读的人。
hint: 按要求用 read 的完成分词形式

text: ____ by the sudden noise, the cat slipped behind the sofa.
cn: 猫被突如其来的声音吓了一跳，溜到了沙发后面。
why: cat 承受 startle 的动作，Startled by…交代它溜走的原因。
tip: Startling 表示令人受惊，用于发出这种影响的事物。
hint: 用 startle 的过去分词表示被动感受

text: With the stage lights ____ directly at us, we couldn't see the audience.
cn: 舞台灯直射着我们，我们看不见观众。
why: lights 主动发光，且和看不见观众同时发生，用 shining。
tip: shone 在此不表示灯被照射后的状态。
hint: 用 shine 的现在分词填空

text: We expect the missing file ____ before noon.
cn: 我们预计丢失的文件会在中午前找回。
why: expect 的宾语 file 承受 find，后面的不定式须用被动形式。
tip: to find 会把 file 当成寻找者。
hint: 用 find 的被动不定式填空

text: The notes seem ____ been left here by a visitor.
cn: 这些笔记似乎是一位访客先前留在这里的。
why: 现在作出推断，留下笔记发生得更早，所以用 seem to have been left。
tip: 普通 to be left 不能同样清楚地标明先前已发生。
hint: 在 been left 前填写缺少的两个词

text: Rewrite in the passive: The staff made us remove our shoes. → We ____ our shoes.
cn: 工作人员要求我们脱鞋。
why: 主动结构 made us remove 变成被动后需要 were made to remove。
tip: 不要把主动句省略 to 的形式直接照搬到被动句。
hint: 改为一般过去时被动句，保留 remove

text: Use worth: You should visit the tiny railway museum. → The tiny railway museum is worth ____.
cn: 那座小小的铁路博物馆值得参观。
why: worth 后接动名词 visiting，主语 museum 是参观的对象。
tip: 不用 worth to visit，也不用 worth being visited。
hint: 用 visit 的正确形式改写

text: Rewrite using prevent: The flood kept cars from entering the tunnel. → The flood prevented cars ____ the tunnel.
cn: 洪水使车辆无法进入隧道。
why: 主动句里 prevent cars from entering 可省略 from，两种都可接受。
tip: 不要写 prevented cars to enter。
hint: 保留 enter，补全 prevent 的搭配

text: The lantern broke while it was ____ from the ceiling.
cn: 那盏灯在被人从天花板上放下来时破了。
why: 灯当时正被放下，was 已有，缺 being lowered。
tip: was lowering 会把灯写成主动放下别的东西。
hint: 用 lower 的进行时被动形式补在 was 后

text: Select both ways to say that the wet coat needs drying.
slots: The wet coat needs to be dried.
cn: 选出两句都能表达「湿外套需要晾干」的句子。
why: needs doing 和 needs to be done 都可以让 coat 表示被处理的物品。
tip: 改变 done 与 be 的顺序会破坏被动不定式。
options: The wet coat needs dried to be.
The wet coat needs to dry the rack.
The wet coat needs to be dried.

text: Which two completions express criticism of a past choice? “You ____ without checking the brake.”
cn: 哪两种补全都表达对先前做法的批评？「你不该没检查刹车就出发。」
why: 两个正确短语都用否定的「应该」加完成形式评价先前的决定。
tip: leave tomorrow 或 need to leave 指向现在或将来。

text: The manager, ____ desk is next to mine, knows the new schedule.
cn: 经理的桌子就在我旁边，他知道新日程。
point: 非限定性从句中的所属
why: desk 属于 manager，逗号后用 whose desk 补充关系。
tip: whom 只作宾语，不能放在 desk 前表示所属。

text: Our bus broke down halfway, ____ made us late for the opening.
cn: 我们的公交车中途抛锚了，这使我们错过了准时参加开幕的机会。
why: 逗号后的 which 指整件「车抛锚」的事，在从句里作 made 的主语。
tip: 非限定性从句里不能用 that 来指代前面整件事。

text: The drawer in ____ we stored old tickets will no longer close.
cn: 我们以前存放旧票的那个抽屉再也关不上了。
why: drawer 指物，in 已被提到从句前，用 in which。
tip: in where 会把地点关系表达两次。

text: The village ____ we visited last spring lies beside a canal.
cn: 我们去年春天参观的那个村庄位于一条运河边。
point: 地点先行词也可作宾语
why: visited 后缺参观的对象，village 在从句中作宾语，因此用 which 或 that。
tip: 不能看见地点名词就填 where，要先看从句缺什么成分。
hint: 填关系代词，保留空格

text: Is this the reason ____ the old timetable was removed?（填关系副词。）
cn: 这就是旧时刻表被撤掉的原因吗？
why: 从句主谓完整，需要修饰原因的关系副词 why。
tip: 若后文是 explain the reason 这类缺宾语的结构，才另考虑关系代词。
hint: 按要求填一个关系副词

text: What matters most is ____ everyone gets a clear role.
cn: 最重要的是每个人都有明确的分工。
why: is 后是一条完整陈述，that 引出说明「最重要的是什么」的内容。
tip: what 需要在从句中另作成分，这里没有缺口。

text: ____ the pair will fit remains unclear until we try them on.
cn: 这双鞋是否合脚，在试穿之前仍不清楚。
why: 整段 Whether the pair will fit 作 remains 的主语，表达尚未确定的选择。
tip: 正式标准用法中不以 if 代替句首这一主语从句的 whether。

text: The notice explains ____ to do if the machine shows a red light.
cn: 通知说明了机器亮红灯时该做什么。
why: do 缺宾语，what 表示要做的事；整个短语作 explains 的宾语。
tip: how to do 通常还需要说明 do 的对象。

text: I agree with ____ you said about adding a handrail.
cn: 我赞同你关于增加扶手所说的话。
why: what 同时表示「所说的内容」，又是 said 的宾语。
tip: that 只起连接作用，无法在这里填补 said 的宾语。

text: You may use the spare room ____ you leave it tidy.
cn: 只要你用完保持整洁，就可以使用备用房间。
why: 整洁是给出许可的前提，用 provided that 表示只要。
tip: even though 表示尽管，不是在提出条件。

text: Check the date before you pay, ____ the ticket can't be exchanged later.
cn: 付款前请核对日期，因为车票之后不能换。
why: 后一分句对前面的建议给出理由，for 在此作并列连词。
tip: so 会将后一分句变成「核对日期」导致的结果。

text: The fan was left on ____ the paint would dry overnight.
cn: 风扇一直开着，为的是让油漆在夜里干透。
why: 故意开着风扇是安排一种条件，so that 引出想达到的目的。
tip: now that 表示既然，无法表达想实现的目标。

text: ____ I know, no one has tested the new route in winter.
cn: 据我所知，还没有人在冬天测试过这条新路线。
why: 这一固定说法限定消息来源和把握程度，表示「据我所知」。
tip: as soon as I know 描述时间，不是限定信息范围。

text: ____ tired you are, don't leave the heater on when you go out.
cn: 无论你多累，出门时都别让取暖器开着。
why: tired 是形容词，However tired you are 相当于 No matter how tired you are。
tip: whatever 通常修饰名词或独立指事物，不能直接代替这里的 however。

text: You can put the stool ____ it won't block the doorway.
cn: 你可以把小凳放在不会挡门的地方。
point: where 引导地点状语从句
why: 主句 put the stool 需要放置地点，where 后面的分句说明合适位置。
tip: which 需要有清楚的先行词或选择范围。

text: The team changed the start time ____ more neighbors could attend.
cn: 团队调整了开始时间，以便更多邻居能参加。
why: more neighbors could attend 是有主语和谓语的分句，in order that 可引出目的。
tip: so as to 后应接原形，不直接接这个分句。

text: The moment I ____ the label, I realized the parcels had been mixed up.
cn: 我一读标签，就意识到包裹弄混了。
point: the moment 引导时间从句
why: the moment 直接作时间连接语；主句 realized 是过去时，read 也用过去式，同形异音。
tip: 不要让原形和过去式同形误导你添加 did。
hint: 用 read 的一般过去时填空

text: This is the second time that the fire alarm ____ off this week.
cn: 这是本周火警警报第二次响起。
why: 在现在参照点统计本周截至此刻的第二次经历，用 has gone off。
tip: off 是短语的一部分，不要只改成普通过去时 went。
hint: 用 go 的现在完成时填空

text: Rewrite using unless: You can't borrow the van if you don't show your license. → You can't borrow the van ____ you show your license.
cn: 除非你出示驾照，否则不能借这辆面包车。
why: unless 已包含否定条件，后面的 show 保持肯定形式。
tip: 不要在 unless 后再否定一次，造成条件反转。
hint: 用题干指定的连词改写

text: Rewrite using whose: A neighbor owns this garden. Her son studies with me. → The neighbor ____ son studies with me owns this garden.
cn: 儿子和我一起学习的那位邻居拥有这座花园。
point: 把所属关系合并进从句
why: her son 中的 her 回指 neighbor，合并时写 whose son。
tip: 不能将原来的 her 和 whose 同时保留。
hint: 用指定关系词合并两句

text: Choose both connectors for a contrast between habits: I set an alarm, ____ my brother wakes up naturally.
cn: 选出两个都可以表示习惯对比的连词：我设闹钟，而我哥哥自然醒。
point: while 与 whereas 表对照
why: 两项长期习惯相对照，whereas 与表示对比的 while 均适用。
tip: in case 意味着为可能情形作准备，会改变逻辑。

text: Which two sentences keep the indirect question in normal word order?
slots: Nobody knows why the gate is locked.
I asked when the guide would arrive.
cn: 哪两句间接问句采用了正确的陈述语序？
point: 间接问句的时态和语序
why: 两句中 the gate 和 the guide 都位于各自的谓语前。
tip: why 和 when 位于从句开头时不代表后面必须倒装。
options: Nobody knows why the gate is locked.
I asked when would the guide arrive.
Nobody knows why is the gate locked.
I asked when the guide would arrive.

text: The fact ____ both keys open the door surprised the owner.
cn: 两把钥匙都能开这扇门，这一事实使主人惊讶。
why: both keys open the door 是完整陈述，说明 fact 的具体内容。
tip: 这里的 that 不充当 open 的主语或宾语。

text: I didn't hear the entire announcement, ____ I may have missed the change of platform.
cn: 我没听全通知，所以可能漏听了换站台的消息。
why: 没听完整是原因，可能错过信息是由此作出的推测，so 连接二者。
tip: in order that 表示目的，不能将漏听写成目的。

text: The red basket is for used pencils. The yellow basket holds new ones. Mei needs a pencil that nobody has used. Which basket should she open?
cn: 红篮子装用过的铅笔，黄篮子装新铅笔。梅需要一支没人用过的铅笔。她该打开哪个篮子？
why: nobody has used 与 new 表达相同条件，因此应选黄篮子。
tip: 先看梅的具体需求，再选颜色。

text: At the pool, Dan leaves his shoes by the door and puts his glasses in a locker. What does Dan put in the locker?
cn: 在游泳池，丹把鞋留在门旁，把眼镜放进储物柜。他把什么放进了储物柜？
why: 第二个动作 puts his glasses in a locker 直接给出物品。
tip: by the door 说明鞋在另一处。

text: A note says, “Lunch is in the fridge. Please heat it first. Love, Dad.” What should the reader do before eating?
cn: 便条写着：“午餐在冰箱里。请先加热。爱你的爸爸。”读者在吃饭之前应该做什么？
why: heat it first 给出吃之前的指令，it 指午餐。
tip: 冰箱是午餐现在的位置，不是下一步动作。
options: Put the lunch in the fridge.

text: The small train leaves the park gate at 10:00. It stops at the lake at 10:15. Where is it scheduled to be at 10:15?
cn: 小火车十点离开公园大门，十点十五分停在湖边。按时刻表，十点十五分它应在哪里？
why: 10:15 对应 stops at the lake。
tip: 区分出发地点与停靠地点。
options: At the station outside the park.

text: Nina counts her coins. She has five yuan. A bun costs three yuan and a pear costs two. What can she buy with exactly five yuan?
cn: 妮娜有五元钱。一个小圆面包三元，一个梨两元。正好花五元，她能买什么？
why: 一个面包和一个梨合计 3＋2＝5 元。
tip: 题目要求“恰好”五元，只买梨会剩钱。

text: “Please bring a spoon. We have enough bowls,” reads the picnic note. Which item is each guest asked to bring?
cn: 野餐留言写着：“请带一把勺子。我们有足够的碗。”每位客人被要求带哪样东西？
why: bring 的宾语是 a spoon；碗已经够用。
tip: 不要把提到的每样东西都当作需要携带的物品。

text: The blue door is locked. A sign on it says, “Visitors, please use the green door on your left.” Where should a visitor go?
cn: 蓝色门锁着。上面的标牌写着：“访客请使用左边的绿色门。”访客应该去哪儿？
why: 标牌直接指向左边的绿门。
tip: locked 表明蓝门无法作为入口。
options: To the back of the building.
To the blue door on the right.

text: Tara's lunch bag has a picture of a boat. The bag with a star belongs to her brother. Which picture identifies Tara's bag?
cn: 塔拉的午餐包上画着一艘船，带星星的包属于哥哥。哪个图案能辨认出塔拉的包？
why: 第一句把 Tara 的包与船对应起来。
tip: 不要把哥哥包上的图案也算在塔拉的包上。

text: One seed is in a glass jar. Two seeds are in a paper cup. How many seeds are in the cup?
cn: 玻璃罐里有一粒种子，纸杯里有两粒。纸杯里有几粒种子？
why: 第二句提供杯中的数量 two。
tip: 三粒是两容器的总数，问题只问纸杯。

text: A shop closes at six. At five, a sign in the window says, “Open.” Can a customer enter at five?
slots: Yes, the shop is still open.
cn: 一家店六点关门。五点时，橱窗里的牌子写着“营业中”。顾客五点可以进店吗？
why: 五点早于关门时间，Open 也确认店正在营业。
tip: 票在文中没有被列作入店条件。
options: Yes, the shop is still open.
Only if the customer has a ticket.

text: A class will meet in Room 4 for drawing. If that room is being cleaned, the class will use Room 6. Today a cleaner is washing the floor in Room 4. Where should the class meet?
cn: 班级本要在四号教室画画，若那里正在打扫，就改用六号教室。今天清洁员正在四号教室洗地。班级该在哪里集合？
why: 清洁员正在洗地，满足使用备用教室的条件。
tip: 第一句是原安排，阅读后文检查是否有变化。

text: Tom wants to borrow a book for seven days. At this library, novels may be kept for two weeks, but magazines for only three days. Which item meets his plan?
cn: 汤姆想借一本读物留七天。这里的小说可借两周，杂志只能借三天。哪一种适合他的计划？
why: 两周超过七天，三天不足七天，因此小说符合。
tip: 比较的是可借上限，并非必须借满两周。

text: The blue team finished its poster first. The yellow team won because its directions were easier to follow. What did the judges value in this decision?
cn: 蓝队最先完成海报，黄队因指引更易理解而获胜。裁判在这次决定中看重什么？
why: because 后明确说明获胜理由是指引清楚。
tip: 先完成和最终获胜分别属于两个队。

text: Ravi's music lesson starts at 4:20. It takes him fifteen minutes to walk there. He leaves home at 4:00. How much time will he have before the lesson if he walks as usual?
cn: 拉维的音乐课四点二十分开始，步行需十五分钟。他四点出门。若按平常速度走，到后离上课还有多久？
why: 四点十五分到达，与四点二十分相差五分钟。
tip: 路上所用时间与到达后的空余时间不同。

text: The notice at a fruit stall says, “Bring your own box on Saturdays and get one extra plum.” Liz brings a box on Friday. Does the notice promise her an extra plum that day?
slots: No, the offer is for Saturdays.
cn: 水果摊通知说：“周六自带盒子，可多得一个李子。”莉兹周五带了盒子。通知承诺当天多给她一个李子吗？
why: 自带盒子和周六是同时满足的条件；莉兹来的是周五。
tip: 只看到有盒子会漏掉日期限制。
options: Yes, because she has a box.
No, the offer is for Saturdays.

text: The puppy runs to the kitchen whenever it hears the tin lid. Today the tin is empty, but the puppy still runs in. What brought it into the kitchen this time?
cn: 小狗一听到罐盖声就会跑向厨房。今天罐子是空的，它仍跑了进来。这次是什么引它进厨房？
why: whenever 与 still 说明小狗对盖子的声音作出反应。
tip: 罐子是空的，因此看到食物不是文中原因。

text: A text reads, “Meet me outside the bakery, not inside. The tables there are full.” What is the sender changing or clarifying?
cn: 短信说：“在面包店外面见，不在里面。那里的桌子都满了。”发信人在说明什么？
why: outside 与 inside 是地点对照，桌满解释了这样安排的原因。
tip: 店名相同，改变的是店内还是店外。

text: A family ticket covers two adults and one child. Jo arrives with one adult and two children. Which detail differs from the ticket description?
slots: The mix of adults and children.
cn: 一张家庭票含两名成人和一名儿童。乔一行有一名成人和两名儿童。哪一点与票面说明不同？
why: 两组都是三人，但成人和儿童的人数分别不同。
tip: 总人数相同不代表票的构成条件也相同。
options: The mix of adults and children.

text: A coach tells Ken, “Your first lap was quick. Save a little energy for the last lap next time.” What change is the coach suggesting?
slots: Start at a pace he can keep up.
cn: 教练对肯说：“你第一圈很快。下次给最后一圈留点体力。”教练建议他怎样调整？
why: 留体力说明起步要更可持续，而不是加快第一圈。
tip: “第一圈快”是观察，建议在后一句。
options: Run the first lap even faster.
Start at a pace he can keep up.

text: A diary entry says, “Monday: I put the wet umbrella by the window. Tuesday: The wind had dried it, so I folded it.” When did the writer fold the umbrella?
slots: On Tuesday, after it had dried.
cn: 日记写着：“周一：我把湿伞放在窗旁。周二：风已经把它吹干，于是我收起了伞。”作者何时收伞？
why: 周二条目中先说已干，再说 folded，可确定日期和先后。
tip: 不要把放伞和收伞看成同一天的同一动作。
options: On Tuesday, while it was still wet.
On Tuesday, after it had dried.
On Monday, before it was dry.

text: A town tested a quiet hour in one market. Twenty shoppers filled in cards; fifteen liked the change. What can the cards show directly?
slots: Most people who returned a card liked the change.
cn: 镇上在一处市场试行安静时段。二十名顾客填写反馈卡，十五人喜欢这一变化。反馈卡能直接说明什么？
why: 十五占二十的大多数，结论范围限于交回卡片的人。
tip: 不能把小范围自愿反馈扩大到全镇。
options: Most people who returned a card liked the change.
Every market should hold a quiet hour.
Most people in town liked the change.

text: The route map marks a footbridge with a dotted line. Its key says dotted lines mean “planned.” A walker needs to cross the river today. What should she check?
slots: Whether a usable crossing exists now.
cn: 路线图上人行桥为虚线，图例说明虚线表示“规划中”。行人今天要过河。她应该核实什么？
why: planned 说明地图记录的是规划；现在通行与否仍需确认。
tip: 地图上画了桥不等于桥已经建成。
options: Whether the dotted line is blue.
Whether a usable crossing exists now.
Whether the river has a name.

text: A cafe sells soup until 2 p.m., but sandwiches until closing at 5. Mia arrives at 2:30 and wants a hot soup and a sandwich. Which part of her order is still listed as available?
cn: 咖啡店下午两点停止供应汤，三明治卖到五点打烊。米娅两点半到，想要热汤和三明治。哪一样仍在供应时段？
why: 两点半已过供汤时间，却早于三明治停售时间。
tip: 同一家店的不同餐品有各自截止时间。
options: Both the soup and the sandwich.

text: A group washed three stained shirts with a new soap. All three looked cleaner. They did not wash any shirt with their usual soap that day. Which comparison is missing?
slots: How the usual soap would clean similar stains.
cn: 一组人用新肥皂洗了三件脏衬衫，三件看起来都更干净。那天他们没用惯常的肥皂洗任何衬衫。缺少哪项比较？
why: 惯常肥皂未参与测试，因此无法与新肥皂比较效果。
tip: 变干净说明有变化，不能据此判定优于其他肥皂。
options: How many shirts they washed with the new soap.
Whether the shirts looked cleaner afterward.
How the usual soap would clean similar stains.

text: A volunteer writes, “I can water the seedlings every evening except Thursday. Could someone cover that day?” What does cover mean here?
slots: Do the task in the volunteer's place.
cn: 一名志愿者写道：“除了周四，我每晚都能给幼苗浇水。有人能 cover 那一天吗？”这里 cover 表示什么？
why: 前文留下周四浇水的任务空缺，因此 cover 是代班。
tip: cover 也可指遮盖，需结合任务安排判断。
options: Put a cloth over the seedlings.
Do the task in the volunteer's place.

text: The concert ticket says, “Keep this stub for re-entry.” A visitor wants to leave during the break and return. Which item should the visitor keep?
cn: 演出票上写着“重新入场请保留此票根”。一名观众想在中场休息时出去再回来。应保留哪样东西？
why: re-entry 是再次进入；票面明确要求保留 stub。
tip: break 说明离场时机，不改变入场凭证。

text: Two notebooks cost the same. One has thick paper but fewer pages; the other has more thin pages. Sami needs many pages for pencil notes, and thick paper is unimportant to him. Which notebook better fits his needs?
slots: The one with more thin pages.
cn: 两本笔记本价格相同。一本纸厚页少，另一本纸薄页多。萨米要记大量铅笔笔记，不在意纸厚。哪本更合适？
why: 明确的优先条件是页数，价格相同且厚度不重要。
tip: 不要把“纸厚”自动视作每个人的优先选择。
options: The one with fewer thick pages.
Only the one with the higher price.
The one with more thin pages.

text: The handout says, “Underline the claim, then circle the example used to support it.” A student circles the claim and underlines the example. What needs changing?
cn: 讲义说：“在论点下划线，再圈出支持论点的例子。”学生圈了论点，给例子划了线。哪里要改？
why: 对象找到了，但标记方式刚好反了，应交换圈和下划线。
tip: 题目问书写操作，不是让学生删改文章内容。

text: The school counted bicycles at its north gate from 7:30 to 8:00. It reported 38. A second gate was not observed. Which title describes the count most accurately?
slots: Bicycles at the north gate during one half-hour.
cn: 学校在七点半至八点统计北门的自行车，共三十八辆，另一道门无人观察。哪个标题最准确？
why: 标题需同时保留一个校门和半小时这两个限制。
tip: 单点计数无法比较所有上学方式。
options: Bicycles at the north gate during one half-hour.
The most popular way to reach school.

text: After losing his paper notes, Eli began photographing each page. “Now a windy day costs me less worry,” he says. Which problem is the new habit meant to reduce?
slots: Losing the information if a page blows away.
cn: 伊莱丢过纸质笔记后开始给每页拍照。他说：“现在刮风天我少操一份心。”这个新习惯想减少哪种麻烦？
why: 即使原纸被吹走，照片仍保留内容，正对应此前丢笔记的经历。
tip: 拍照无法阻止纸被吹走，只能减少信息损失。
options: Having too many photos on his phone.
Taking too long to write each page.
Losing the information if a page blows away.

text: A notice says, “The side gate is closed while the wall is repaired. Deliveries may still enter through the yard.” A driver assumes all entrances are closed. Which phrase corrects that assumption?
slots: Deliveries may still enter through the yard.
cn: 通知说：“修墙期间侧门关闭。送货车辆仍可从院子进入。”司机认为所有入口都关闭了。哪句话能纠正他的理解？
why: still 与 through the yard 指明送货车辆有可用的替代入口。
tip: 一个入口关闭，不能推断所有入口都关闭。
options: Deliveries may still enter through the yard.

text: Three classes voted on a reading room. Class A sent 8 votes for it out of 10 votes cast; Class B sent 12 out of 20. Which comparison is correct?
slots: B had more votes for it, but A had a higher share in favor.
cn: 三个班就阅览室投票。A班所投十票中八票赞成，B班所投二十票中十二票赞成。哪项比较正确？
why: B 赞成票数为十二，高于八；A 赞成比例为八成，高于 B 的六成。
tip: 票数与比例的分母不同，需分别比较。
options: B had more votes for it, but A had a higher share in favor.
B had a higher share because 12 is larger than 8.
A had both more votes for it and a higher share.

text: Lea wrote, “I expected the repair to be quick. Two hours later I was still looking for the right screw.” Which attitude is most clearly suggested?
slots: Surprise at how long a small detail took.
cn: 莉娅写道：“我原以为修理很快就好。两小时后我还在找合适的螺丝。”最明显反映出什么感受？
why: expected quick 与 two hours later still 构成落差；文字没有指责任何人。
tip: 不要从耗时直接推测作者在生谁的气。
options: Pride that the whole job ended early.
Surprise at how long a small detail took.
Anger at someone who lost the screw.

text: A recycling chart counts bottles by number, not by weight. On Tuesday there were more bottles, but most were tiny. What further fact is needed to compare the total weight from Monday and Tuesday?
slots: The weight of the bottles collected on each day.
cn: 回收图按瓶子的个数统计。周二瓶子更多，但大多很小。要比较周一和周二瓶子的总重量，还需什么？
why: 瓶数与单件重量都会影响总重，直接称出两天各自总重即可比较。
tip: 瓶子多不一定更重。
options: The color of the smallest bottles.
The number of collectors on Tuesday.
The weight of the bottles collected on each day.

text: At a library meeting, Jo said, “Longer opening hours would help, provided there is an evening bus.” What is Jo's position?
slots: Support that depends on transport being available.
cn: 图书馆会议上，乔说：“如果晚上有公交，延长开放时间会有帮助。”乔的立场是什么？
why: provided 引出成立条件，说明支持依赖夜间交通。
tip: 忽略条件从句就会把有条件支持读成无条件支持。
options: Support for longer hours under all conditions.
Support that depends on transport being available.

text: The sign by an orchard reads, “Take fallen fruit only.” A visitor picks an apple from a low branch because it is near the ground. Has the visitor followed the sign?
slots: No. The apple was still attached to the tree.
cn: 果园边的牌子写着“只可取落果”。访客从低枝上摘了一个苹果，理由是它接近地面。这样符合要求吗？
why: fallen 描述已掉落的状态；树枝低并不说明果实脱离了树。
tip: 区分“位置靠下”和“已经掉落”。
options: Yes. Any low apple counts as fallen.
No. The apple was still attached to the tree.
Yes, if the visitor eats it immediately.

text: The workshop has six seats. Its form says, “Submitting a form does not reserve a seat. Wait for our confirmation email.” Jia receives a copy of her form but no confirmation. What can she conclude?
slots: Her seat has not yet been confirmed.
cn: 工作坊有六个名额，表格写着“提交表格并不预留名额，请等候确认邮件”。嘉只收到了表格副本。她能得出什么结论？
why: 副本证明提交过表格，不等同于明确的名额确认。
tip: 没有确认也不能推出名额一定已满。
options: Her seat has not yet been confirmed.
Every seat has already been taken.
She definitely has one of the six seats.

text: A coach measured the same runner on a flat track one day and a steep path the next. The second time was slower. Which fact makes a direct judgment about fitness difficult?
cn: 教练先在平坦跑道、次日在陡坡上为同一跑者计时。第二次更慢。哪一事实让直接判断体能变化变得困难？
why: 场地难度不同，第二次变慢可能与坡度有关。
tip: 跑者相同并不能抵消路线不同的影响。
options: The coach used the word slower.
The same runner took both tests.

text: A photo caption says, “The square, usually crowded, just after the last bus on a rainy Tuesday.” What does the caption suggest about an empty square in this photo?
slots: The scene may be unusual for that place.
cn: 照片说明写着“平常拥挤的广场，摄于雨天周二末班车刚过之后”。这对照片中的空广场有什么提示？
why: usually crowded 与特殊的天气和时间提醒读者照片并非日常全貌。
tip: 一张照片只能直接展示拍摄当时。
options: The square is always empty on weekdays.
The town has stopped running buses.
The scene may be unusual for that place.

text: Two versions of a recipe use the same amount of flour. One says “a cup of chopped nuts”; the other says “chop a cup of nuts.” Why might the final amounts differ?
slots: One measures the nuts after chopping and the other before.
cn: 两版食谱所用面粉相同。一版写“一杯切碎的坚果”，另一版写“把一杯坚果切碎”。最终坚果用量为什么可能不同？
why: chopped 作定语，说明量取时已经切碎；chop 作动作，发生在量取之后。
tip: 两个 cup 容积可以相同，差异来自装入的坚果形态。
options: One measures the nuts after chopping and the other before.
One uses a larger cup by definition.
One adds flour to the measuring cup first.

text: A school tried a reminder bell for a week. Late arrivals fell from 12 to 6, but the nearby road also reopened that week. Which conclusion is best supported?
slots: Fewer late arrivals were recorded, but the bell's separate effect is unclear.
cn: 学校试用提醒铃一周，迟到人数从十二降到六；附近道路也恰在那周恢复通行。哪项结论最有依据？
why: 迟到减少是记录事实；铃和道路同时变化，无法单独确定铃的效果。
tip: 时间上同时发生不等于已经确定唯一原因。
options: Fewer late arrivals were recorded, but the bell's separate effect is unclear.
The road reopening had no possible effect.
The bell alone prevented six late arrivals.

text: A club advertised a 50% increase in Saturday attendance. Its register rose from 4 names to 6. Which wording keeps both the proportion and its scale clear?
slots: Attendance rose by two people, from four to six.
cn: 社团宣传周六到场人数增长了百分之五十，登记人数从四人变为六人。哪种表达同时交代比例和规模？
why: 增加两人相对原来的四人是百分之五十，同时列出起止数便于判断规模。
tip: 百分比不是新增人数，也不代表全镇人口比例。
options: Half the town joined the club on Saturday.
Attendance rose by two people, from four to six.

text: A writer says, “The route is shorter on paper; on wet days the steps may cost more time than the extra street.” Which claim does the writer question?
slots: The shortest route always takes the least time.
cn: 作者写道：“图上这条路线更短；雨天走台阶花的时间可能比绕一条街还多。”作者质疑哪种说法？
why: 作者承认地图距离更短，用雨天的速度限制质疑“最短一定最快”。
tip: 不要把作者承认的事实误当作被质疑的观点。
options: The route with steps is shorter on the map.
Wet steps can slow a walker.
The shortest route always takes the least time.

text: The gardening team changed two things at once: it watered earlier and moved the pots into shade. Wilting became less common. Which follow-up would best separate the two changes?
slots: Compare similar pots while changing one condition at a time.
cn: 园艺组同时提前浇水、把花盆移到阴凉处，萎蔫减少了。哪种后续做法最有助于区分两项改变的作用？
why: 其他条件尽量相同、一次改变一项，才能更清楚地区分效应。
tip: 只挑仍萎蔫的盆会忽视没有萎蔫的情况。
options: Compare similar pots while changing one condition at a time.
Count only the pots that still wilt.
Change both things again in all pots.

text: A repair guide says, “If the screen stays dark after charging, check the cable before replacing the screen.” Which assumption does the guide warn against?
slots: A dark screen must mean the screen itself is broken.
cn: 维修指南写着：“充电后屏幕仍黑，换屏前先检查线缆。”指南提醒人们避免什么假设？
why: 指南给出另一种可能原因，因此不能把现象直接等同于屏幕损坏。
tip: 优先检查线缆不等于认定线缆必坏。
options: A dark screen must mean the screen itself is broken.
A faulty cable can affect the result.

text: At a meeting, Lin said, “I agree the path needs lighting. My question is whether these lamps shine into bedroom windows.” Which response addresses Lin's concern?
slots: Show where the lamps point and how their light is shielded.
cn: 会上，林说：“我同意小路需要照明。我想问，这些灯会不会照进卧室窗户？”哪种回应切中林的顾虑？
why: 林已赞同照明目标，关注的是灯光方向及对屋内的影响。
tip: 重复双方同意的目标不能回答具体顾虑。
options: Repeat that walkers need a lit path.
Show where the lamps point and how their light is shielded.
List the total number of residents.

text: A notice promises, “We reply within two working days.” It says the desk works Monday to Friday and is closed on holidays. Which detail is needed to give a reliable reply date for a Friday message?
slots: Whether the following weekdays include a holiday.
cn: 通知承诺“两个工作日内回复”。服务台周一至周五办公，假日关闭。要给周五的留言估算可靠回复日期，还需确认什么？
why: 工作日排除周末与休假日，接下来的工作日是否遇假日会影响推算。
tip: 两个工作日不能机械当作两个自然日。
options: Whether the following weekdays include a holiday.

text: A book review says, “The ending surprised me, though it follows fairly from clues in the first chapter.” What combination of ideas does the reviewer express?
slots: The ending was unexpected but supported by earlier details.
cn: 书评写道：“结尾让我惊讶，尽管它合乎第一章中的线索。”评论者同时表达了哪两层意思？
why: surprised 表示出乎意料，follows fairly from clues 表示回头看有依据。
tip: “意外”并不必然表示“毫无铺垫”。
options: The clues were added after the ending.
The ending was obvious and unsupported.
The ending was unexpected but supported by earlier details.

text: A bus company said, “Complaints dropped after our new timetable.” A passenger asks how many journeys were made in each period. Why is that question relevant?
slots: Fewer journeys could lower the number of complaints even if the complaint rate stayed similar.
cn: 公交公司说：“新时刻表施行后投诉减少了。”一名乘客追问两个时段各有多少次乘车。这个问题为什么相关？
why: 要判断每次乘车的投诉率，需同时知道投诉数和乘车次数。
tip: 总数变化与每次乘车的比例变化并非同一问题。
options: Every journey always causes one complaint.
Fewer journeys could lower the number of complaints even if the complaint rate stayed similar.

text: Two drafts describe a missed bus. Draft A says, “We were careless.” Draft B says, “We reached the stop at 8:12; the bus had left at 8:10.” Which feature of Draft B helps a reader judge the event independently?
slots: It gives observable times rather than only a judgment.
cn: 两份稿子写同一次错过公交。A稿说“我们太粗心了”；B稿说“我们八点十二分到站，车八点十分已开走”。B稿的什么特点让读者能独立判断？
why: 具体时间可核对先后；B稿没有交代出门原因或所有乘客的情况。
tip: 证据能说明到站晚于发车，不能自动说明迟到的原因。
options: It proves nobody could have caught the bus.
It gives observable times rather than only a judgment.
It says why the writers left home late.

text: I put two apples into my bag. One is for me, and the ____ is for my sister. I give ____ the bigger one.
cn: 我把两个苹果放进包里。一个给我，另一个给妹妹。我把大一点的给她。
point: 两者中的另一个与宾格
why: 两个苹果已确定，one 对应 the other；give 后指妹妹要用宾格 her。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: A sign beside the pond says, “Please do ____ feed the ducks.” We keep our bread ____ the bag and watch the ducks swim.
cn: 池塘边的牌子上写着“请勿喂鸭子”。我们把面包留在包里，看鸭子游泳。
why: do not feed 表示禁止喂食；面包在包里用 in。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: The new map is ____ the classroom wall. To find our town, look ____ a small blue star.
cn: 新地图挂在教室的墙上。要找到我们镇，请找一颗蓝色的小星星。
why: 物品挂在墙面上用 on；look for 表示寻找目标。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: There ____ four cups on the table, but only one ____ clean. We wash the other three before tea.
cn: 桌上有四个杯子，但只有一个是干净的。喝茶前我们把另三个洗了。
why: four cups 是复数，只有一个杯子时主语变为 one，分别用 are 和 is。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: Amy has a little drum. She ____ it after school, but she never plays it ____ night because the baby is asleep.
cn: 埃米有一面小鼓。她放学后打鼓，但夜里从不打，因为宝宝睡着了。
point: 第三人称单数与时间短语
why: 描述日常习惯，she 后用 plays；表示“在夜里”用 at night。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: A boy drops his bus card. I pick ____ up and hand it ____ the driver so the boy can get it back.
cn: 一个男孩的公交卡掉了。我捡起它并递给司机，这样男孩就能拿回公交卡。
why: it 指单数的卡，放在 pick 和 up 之间；hand something to someone 表示把某物递给某人。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: We buy milk ____ eggs for breakfast. There are no eggs left at the first shop, ____ we try the next one.
cn: 我们买牛奶和鸡蛋当早餐。第一家店没有鸡蛋了，所以我们又去下一家。
why: 购物清单中的两样东西用 and；没鸡蛋是原因，去下一家是结果，用 so。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: My coat has two pockets. The key is in ____, and my coin is in the ____. I check both before I leave.
cn: 我的外套有两个口袋。钥匙在一个里，硬币在另一个里。出门前我检查两个口袋。
why: 说一对口袋中的一个和另一个，用 one … the other。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: A little girl can't reach the shelf. Her dad is ____ enough to take the book ____ for her.
cn: 小女孩够不到书架。她爸爸个子够高，可以帮她把书拿下来。
why: tall 修饰人的身高，enough 放在它后面；书从架上下来，方向用 down。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: This is our class calendar. ____ day has a box, and I put a star ____ today's box.
cn: 这是我们的班级日历。每一天都有一个方格，我在今天的方格里画了一颗星。
point: 限定词与方格内的位置
why: 后面是单数 day，each 可以逐个指每一天；星画在格内用 in。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: We need paper for a poster. Dad gives us ____ sheets, but he doesn't have ____ glue left.
cn: 我们做海报需要纸。爸爸给了我们几张，但他一点胶水也没有了。
point: 肯定句和否定句中的数量词
why: 给了几张纸用 some；doesn't have any 表示一点也没有。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: The lights go off in the hall. I can't ____ the stairs, but I can ____ our teacher calling from the door.
cn: 大厅的灯灭了。我看不见楼梯，但能听到老师在门口呼喊。
why: 光线消失影响视觉，第一空用 see；叫喊声通过听觉感知，第二空用 hear。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: Yesterday, a small ball ____ under the piano. This morning it was still ____, next to the back leg.
cn: 昨天，一个小球滚到了钢琴下面。今天早上它还在那里，就在后面的琴腿旁。
why: yesterday 提示 roll 要用过去式 rolled；there 指前句的钢琴下面。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: Mina usually takes a bus, but today she is ____ her bike. The bus stop is closed ____ workers are fixing the road.
cn: 米娜平常坐公交车，但今天她正骑自行车。公交车站关闭了，因为工人们正在修路。
why: is 后接 riding；后句说明车站关闭的原因，用 because 引导。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: The school play begins ____ six. We get there half an hour ____, so we have time to find our seats.
cn: 学校话剧六点开始。我们提前半小时到，因此有时间找座位。
why: 具体钟点前用 at；有时间找座位说明比开始时间早，用 early。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: Ben was outside ____ the rain began. He ran inside and hung his wet jacket ____ the door, out of sight.
cn: 下雨时本在外面。他跑进屋，把湿夹克挂在门后，从外面看不见。
why: when 引出开始下雨的时刻；结合译文和 out of sight，夹克在门后。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: I left a question ____ the guide on a card. She wrote the answer ____ the back and gave it to me.
cn: 我在卡片上给导游留了一个问题。她把答案写在背面，然后把卡片给我。
why: for the guide 表示问题是留给导游的；字写在卡片背面，用 on。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: Lily forgot her paintbrush, so I lent her ____. We cleaned both brushes ____ the art lesson ended.
cn: 莉莉忘了带画笔，所以我把我的借给她了。美术课结束后我们把两支画笔都洗了。
why: mine 代替 my paintbrush，后面不再跟名词；洗笔发生在下课以后，用 after。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: I thought the soup was hot, ____ it was cold. I asked Dad to heat it ____ before we ate.
cn: 我以为汤是热的，但它是凉的。我请爸爸在吃饭前把汤热一热。
why: hot 和 cold 形成转折，用 but；heat up 表示加热。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: The path was much ____ than the road, so we chose it. We reached the picnic table ____ the others arrived.
cn: 小路比大路短得多，因此我们选了小路。在其他人到达前，我们就到了野餐桌旁。
why: than 提示用 short 的比较级 shorter；我们先到，用 before。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: The clock above the sink was five minutes ____. When it showed seven, the bus had ____ left at 7:03.
cn: 水池上方的钟慢了五分钟。它显示七点时，七点零三分的公交车已经开走了。
point: 钟表快慢与已发生的事
why: 钟显示七点时实际是七点零五，说明钟慢了；公交车更早离开，用 already。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: Nora told me ____ to open the window. A bird had built a nest on the sill, and she didn't want to frighten ____.
cn: 诺拉告诉我别开窗。窗台上有一只鸟筑了巢，她不想吓到它。
why: tell someone not to do 是让某人别做；it 指前面的单数 bird。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: We were ____ by the cinema when our friends called. They had gone to a different cinema ____ the same name.
cn: 朋友们打电话时，我们正在电影院旁等。他们去了一家同名的别的电影院。
why: were 后接 waiting 表示当时的动作；with the same name 表示具有同一名字。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: The teacher cut a long ribbon ____ four pieces. She gave each group ____ piece to measure.
cn: 老师把一条长丝带剪成四段。她给每组一段，让大家量长度。
why: cut … into pieces 表示剪成若干段；each group 得到一段，用 one。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: A note on the machine said it was out ____ order. Instead ____ pressing the button again, Kai asked a worker for help.
cn: 机器上的便条说它出了故障。凯没有再按按钮，而是找工作人员帮忙。
why: out of order 表示故障；instead of 后可接 pressing，表示用另一做法代替。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: Our science group kept one plant in the dark ____ the other stood in sunlight. After a week, the second plant looked much ____.
cn: 我们科学小组把一株植物放在黑暗中，而另一株放在阳光下。一周后，第二株看起来健康得多。
why: while 在此对照两种环境；much 修饰比较级 healthier，说明两株的差异。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: Rita wasn't sure ____ the gate was locked or not. She pulled it gently ____ putting her key in the lock.
cn: 丽塔不确定门是否锁了。她先轻轻拉了一下，然后才把钥匙插进锁孔。
point: whether or not 与动作顺序
why: whether … or not 表达是否；先拉门后插钥匙，前一个动作发生在 putting 之前。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: The baker took the cake out ____ soon. It was still soft in the middle, so he put it ____ in the oven.
cn: 面包师把蛋糕拿出来得太早了。中间还是软的，所以他把蛋糕放回烤箱。
why: 中心没烤好说明时间过早，用 too；回到原来的烤箱用 back。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: The art club has used this room ____ March. It has held four shows here ____ far.
cn: 美术社自三月起就一直使用这间教室。到目前为止，它已在这里办了四场展览。
why: March 是起点，用 since；so far 表示从过去到现在为止。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: Ella was the only rider ____ noticed the fallen sign. She stopped ____ move it off the cycle path.
cn: 埃拉是唯一注意到倒下的指示牌的骑车人。她停下来，把它移出自行车道。
point: 定语从句与目的不定式
why: who 指代 rider，在从句中作主语；停下的目的是移开牌子，用 to move。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: The museum lets students in ____ free on Fridays. No ticket has to be ____, but each student must show a school card.
cn: 博物馆周五让学生免费入馆。无需买票，但每名学生必须出示学生证。
why: for free 表示免费；票是被购买的，be 后用 buy 的过去分词 bought。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: A mechanic checked the front wheel first, ____ the back one. The noise didn't stop ____ he tightened a loose screw.
cn: 修理工先检查前轮，再检查后轮。直到他拧紧一颗松螺丝，噪声才消失。
why: then 承接 first；didn't stop until 表示此前一直有声音。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: The twins made their costumes ____. Only the buttons were ____ by their grandmother in a small envelope.
cn: 双胞胎亲手做了戏服。只有纽扣是祖母用小信封寄来的。
why: themselves 强调双胞胎亲自做；纽扣是被寄出的，用 sent。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。

text: I saved a copy of the drawing ____ case the original got wet. When rain fell on my bag, I was glad I had ____ so.
cn: 我保存了一份画的副本，以防原画被弄湿。雨落在我的包上时，我很庆幸自己此前这样做了。
why: in case 表示提前防备；had done so 中的 done so 代替保存副本一事。
tip: 结合全文选择并核对每一空。
